malaysian.spm: Credit in Bahasa Malaysia/Bahasa Melayu and Pass in Sejarah. Credit in Mathematics and three other subjects from: Prinsip Perakaunan, Perdagangan, Ekonomi Asas, Additional Mathematics, Physics, Biology, Chemistry.
malaysian.stpm: Minimum CGPA 2.00 with Grade C in 3 subjects including Pengajian Am. Minimum CGPA 3.00 with Grade B in any TWO of: Perakaunan, Ekonomi, Mathematics M, Mathematics T, Pengajian Perniagaan, Physics, Biology, Chemistry. Grade B in SPM Mathematics and three other specified subjects. MUET Band 3. Pass interview.
